title: Connection, Growth, and Community: What Syracuse ERGs Accomplished in 2026
summary: By Kathy Anderson, Sr. Sales Operations Analyst Strong workplace communities are built one conversation, one relationship, and one shared experience
body_markdown:
**By Kathy Anderson,** **Sr. Sales Operations Analyst**


[Strong workplace communities](https://novanta.com/careers-culture/life-at-novanta/) are built one conversation, one relationship, and one shared experience at a time.


That’s why Employee Resource Groups are so important.


Throughout 2026, ERGs at our Syracuse, New York, site created opportunities for employees to connect, learn, volunteer, and grow. From professional development and wellness activities to community service and cultural celebrations, each event helped strengthen relationships across teams and functions.


While every ERG has its own focus, they all serve a common purpose: creating spaces where employees feel welcome, supported, and empowered to contribute. That sense of belonging often becomes the foundation for professional growth, relationship building, and leadership development.


As Kyle McDonald, Supply Chain Manager and Chair of the Novanta Professionals Network, explained, we want people to have a space where they feel welcome, whether they’re just onboarding or are years into their career. We want to support people’s growth, both professionally and personally.


That commitment to growth extends beyond event participation. ERGs provide opportunities for employees to lead initiatives, organize activities, collaborate across departments, and gain experience that supports their professional development.


As Kyle shared, supporting the community is huge. It’s about doing all we can to give back to those in need around us.


What stands out most is the impact these groups have on the employee experience. ERGs create opportunities for people to connect, learn, and feel supported. For Kyle, that’s what makes ERGs worthwhile: knowing everything that people balance day to day and being able to make someone’s day or week a little bit better.


As we move forward, our commitment remains the same: creating opportunities for employees to connect, grow, and contribute. When people feel supported and engaged, everyone benefits, from our teams and sites to the communities around us.
